title: BLF Human Review Practice Items
purpose: Training and calibration examples for native evaluators prior to analytical pilot evaluation.
usage_rule: Practice items are excluded from Inter-Annotator Agreement (IAA) calculation and Gold dataset promotion.

items.context: Casual everyday dining setting at home.
items.intended_meaning: I am having lunch / eating rice.
items.guidance_for_reviewer: Candidate A is standard neutral SOV (NATURAL_STANDARD). Candidate B has colloquial postverbal focus (NATURAL_COLLOQUIAL or MARKED_BUT_VALID). Both can be acceptable, with A preferred in neutral context.

items.context: Polite request to a respected teacher or senior colleague.
items.guidance_for_reviewer: Candidate B has correct 2nd person honorific verbal agreement (NATURAL_STANDARD). Candidates A and C have honorific clashes (UNGRAMMATICAL). Preferred: [B].

items.context: Response in a discussion where the speaker was unaware of a recent announcement.
items.intended_meaning: I actually did not know that.
items.guidance_for_reviewer: Illustrates particle placement ('তো'). Both forms are idiomatic. If acceptability depends on discourse presupposition, select NEEDS_CONTEXT or MARKED_BUT_VALID.
